blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приказа́ние — order, instruction; созна́ние — consciousness (awareness); явле́ние — phenomenon; назва́ние — name, appellation, title.
**тре́бование** — demand, request, claim (act of requesting). Wiktionary: тре́бовать + -ание.
